verdict.rationale: Filee's own docs list "metadata" among the per-file-type preset options. Those presets can be applied from the CLI via `--preset`, which suggests developer-controllable metadata handling during conversion. However, this is a single thin mention that never says whether metadata is preserved, stripped, or both. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of metadata preservation across conversions, an explicit strip-on-request option and which formats/fields it covers, document/media (non-image) metadata handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
